spec.name: M5.TupleCompletion.divisibility_sum
spec.statement: ∀ (P Z : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T d k : ℕ) (t : Fin k → Fin (T / d)), (P ∣ Z + M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.ArithmeticTuple.tuplePolynomial T d k t) = AdjoinRoot.mk P Z)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero and map_add. Binary quotient has x+x=0, so x+y=0 iff y=x. No nonzero selected residue or irreducibility premise. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.TupleCompletion.completion_R_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (Z : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T d k : ℕ), M5.ArithmeticTuple.R P hP T d k (AdjoinRoot.mk P Z) = (M5.TupleCompletion.count P Z T d k : ℤ)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Rewrite M5.ArithmeticTuple.R_exact, unfold TupleCompletion.count and equate filtered-cardinality predicates by divisibility_sum. This is the arbitrary selected-polynomial residue version of anchored_R_count. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.TupleCompletion.restricted_completion_R
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (Z : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T d k : ℕ), 0 < T → d ∣ T → M5.ArithmeticTuple.R P hP T d k (AdjoinRoot.mk P Z) = (M5.TupleCompletion.restrictedCount P Z T d k : ℤ)
queries: finite set cardinality bijection natural division
spec.guidance: Use completion_R_count plus accepted M5.AnchoredTupleCount.multiples_equivalence to transfer tuples pointwise j -> d*j. Finset.card_bij with this map matches divisibility polynomial exactly; inverse coordinates r/d are unique. Same finite-domain transport as restricted_R_count but Z is arbitrary. Avoid assuming definitional equality of different Decidable instances: prove predicate equivalence by simp/cases if needed. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
